test_vectors.area: ABI trait integration and complete-message validation
coverage: Every JSON root category, exact whitespace preservation, duplicate raw object keys, escaped Unicode, large numeric lexemes, and dyn JsonEncode dispatch
Malformed or multiple roots, truncated containers, BOM, invalid UTF-8, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, and unescaped controls
Trait errors after producing valid JSON retain their original metadata and never touch the external sink
Inclusive output, depth, container, string-byte, and number-byte limits, including scalar-only zero resource allowances
Schema-position slot mapping, sparse and maximum FieldIds, deterministic field order, empty field names, optional omission, required-field rejection, and explicit raw null
Empty schema, exact slot-vector length, reject_unknown policy, global duplicate names and identifiers, and exact required_count
Required-count overflow beyond u16::MAX, reversed bounds, incompatible scalar constraint families, and unconstrained fields
Every named format is rejected, including empty or unknown names on absent fields and formats alongside other malformed metadata
Both Boolean schema tags, u64::MAX, i64::MIN, negative floating zero, finite fractions, NaN payloads, and both infinities
Fixed-scale quoted decimals, leading fractional zeros, i128::MIN at scales zero and 38, and invalid scales 39 and 255
Signed and unsigned integer bound endpoints, adjacent out-of-range values, exact comparisons around 2^53, and negative zero
Integer grammar excludes fractions and exponents even when mathematically integral; arbitrarily long integer tokens are compared exactly to one-sided bounds
Decimal length constraints measure the actual fixed-scale string representation

test_vectors.area: Owner resolution, Unicode, and raw-span revalidation
coverage: Payload and decoded-arena string owners, checked empty/end spans, escaped output controls, and exact scalar_len metadata
Out-of-owner and overflowing spans, split UTF-8 sequences, and incorrect scalar counts
Raw fragments preserve spelling and revalidate syntax, exact parser diagnostics, scalar categories, nested limits, and actual string or integer constraints
Supplementary Unicode surrogate pairs, literal multibyte scalars, combining characters, escaped NUL, and zero-length bounds
Validation and schema errors perform no external reservations or writes, even after earlier buffered fields
External prefix bytes do not consume the new-message allowance
Reserve failures, partial write failures, error source and schema metadata preservation, and invalid short successful writes
Object delimiters, escaped keys, rebased raw nesting, number limits, and decimal string limits count toward the correct inclusive budgets
Public encode_slots signature assertion
All slot vectors exercise the complete private encode_values implementation called directly by encode_slots
No test fabricates ValidationProof or uses unsafe code; the frozen ABI exposes no safe proof constructor through the allowed dependencies
